key_fields.name: WS-DB2-COMMON-VARS
key_fields.meaning: Group of common DB2 working variables.

key_fields.name: WS-DISP-SQLCODE
key_fields.meaning: Edited (----9) display form of SQLCODE used when building error messages.

key_fields.name: WS-DUMMY-DB2-INT
key_fields.meaning: Receiving host variable for the connectivity priming query SELECT 1 FROM SYSIBM.SYSDUMMY1.

key_fields.name: WS-DB2-CURRENT-ACTION
key_fields.meaning: 72-byte description of the DB2 action in progress, used as message prefix.

key_fields.name: WS-DSNTIAC-FORMATTED
key_fields.meaning: DSNTIAC output area: length (+720) followed by 10 lines of 72 bytes of formatted SQL error text (WS-DSNTIAC-FMTD-TEXT-LINE).

key_fields.name: WS-DSNTIAC-ERROR
key_fields.meaning: Fallback text 'DSNTIAC CD' plus 2-digit DSNTIAC return code (WS-DSNTIAC-ERR-CD redefining WS-DSNTIAC-ERR-CD-X), used when DSNTIAC itself fails.

observations.text: The copybook starts at level 05 with no 01 parent; the including program must place it under its own 01 group.
WS-DSNTIAC-ERR-CD is PIC 9(02); RETURN-CODE values above 99 would be truncated when assigned in CSDB2RPY.

purpose: Common DB2 working storage for CardDemo CICS/DB2 programs. It defines the SQLCODE display field, a dummy integer for the connectivity priming query, the WS-DB2-OK / WS-DB2-ERROR processing flag, the current-action message prefix, and the buffers used to call IBM's DSNTIAC message formatter. It is the data counterpart of CSDB2RPY and is included by COTRTLIC (EXEC SQL INCLUDE CSDB2RWY).
